citations.narrative:
Certain areas where the public could contact animals lacked an attendant or employee. During inspection, a public
member was seen petting a cow inside the dark blue barn and other public members could contact sheep and goats
inside the same barn. This area inside the barn is not visible to the gate attendant and the petting zoo attendant. Lack of
attendants/employees in areas that contact with animals is permitted does not ensure the safety of the animals and the
public. A responsible, knowledgeable, and readily identifiable employee or attendant must be present at all times during
periods of public contact.
***Correct from 8/29/2026 forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
